final_text: Based on the published NHANES Exposome-Wide Association Study (EP-WAS) results by Patel et al. (2012, "Systematic evaluation of environmental factors: persistent pollutants and nutrients correlated with serum uric acid," *International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health*), the pooled meta-analytic β coefficient for PFOA (LBXPFOA) in relation to serum uric acid (LBXSUA) under model 6 (adjusted for age, age², sex, and ethnicity) is **β = 0.13**.
